decision.action: Remove all six from the R11-02 review design per the user's preference unless specifically required by JLC
decision.basis: The explicit add-one-hole-per-item requirement located in the mailbox concerns 13 test coupons. The later engineer-checked answer allows existing usable hanging holes instead of an extra hole. No supplier instruction requiring these six full-size holes was found.
decision.limit: Floor, front and back are slot-only after removal. JLC's October 6 refusal to use slots was not expressly withdrawn; revised full-size hanging methods remain unconfirmed.

causal_carryover.text: The dedicated-hole practice appears to have carried over from the R9 coupon revision into the R10 full-size implementation; no supplier instruction documenting that transfer was found.
